title: General
text: In a PDU session of IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6 and Ethernet PDU session type, the NAS protocol enables different forwarding treatments of UL user data packets in one or more QoS flows based on signalled QoS rules, derived QoS rules or any combination of them
In a PDU session of Unstructured PDU session type, all UL user data packets are associated with the same QoS flow
